law: A hypothesis that was tested and failed is recorded here so no later generation re-selects it unchanged. Re-running a falsified candidate spends generations confirming what was already disproved.

refutations.hypothesis: The G0 corpus saturates because its tasks are too easy: each is a direct read of a value the repository already states.
refutations.discriminatingTest: Add tasks whose answers require deriving a value no artifact states directly. If scores fall below 1.0, difficulty was the cause.
refutations.observation: G1 raised measured dimensions from 4 to 9 with derived cross-artifact answers and still scored 1.0 on every one. Difficulty was not the cause.
refutations.consequence: Promoted the successor diagnosis BN-EVAL-MEASURES-CONSISTENCY-NOT-CAPABILITY: a deterministic assertion over repository artifacts measures internal consistency the test suite already enforces, not capability.
